intro.text: Here is a short story in three parts. Enjoy the tale while your fingers do the work.
intro.tip: If you make a mistake, carry on. Smooth and steady wins the race.

steps.title: The lighthouse – part one
steps.text: On a rocky island far out at sea stood an old lighthouse. Every night, its keeper, a kind woman called Morwenna, climbed the 98 steps to light the great lamp.

steps.title: The lighthouse – part two
steps.text: One stormy evening, she spotted a small boat tossed by the waves. "Hold on!" she whispered, and she turned the lamp towards it, sweeping the beam across the dark water.

steps.title: The lighthouse – part three
steps.text: Guided by the light, the boat reached the harbour safely. The next morning, the grateful fishermen left a basket of fresh bread and honey at her door.
